profile.name: 实验室设备套接字通信接口
profile.description: 这是一个基于网络套接字的实验室自动化通信组件，用于在主控端与远程实验设备或设备服务之间传递命令、状态和对象数据。它适用于需要集中控制、远程调用和多设备管理的实验室自动化场景。
profile.description_en: This is a network socket communication component for laboratory automation, used to exchange commands, status information, and serialized objects between a master controller and remote laboratory devices or device services. It is suited for lab automation setups requiring centralized control, remote interaction, and multi-device management.
